# /sw:doctor

Checks that Shipwright is really there for this project: marketplace known, sw@shipwright installed and enabled, modules, hooks, versions. Read only.

Arguments: `$ARGUMENTS`. Talk to the user in the project's report language.

Run from the project root (the folder with `.quality/project.json`):

```bash
node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sw.mjs" doctor $ARGUMENTS
```

If Playwright is missing, ask the user whether to run `/sw:browser-setup` (pack cache, not the project).

Then read the JSON the command printed (and the file it names, and the screenshots if any) and tell the user, briefly: what passed, what failed and where, what was not checked. If something is missing, give the user the exact commands to type in a terminal; do not run claude plugin commands yourself unless they ask.
